correctness.rationale: Recomputed Q=1+zf″/f′=(1+aw²+4bw³)/(1−aw²−2bw³), Schur transform Φ=w²(a+3bw)/(1+bw³). Double Schwarz lemma yields |a|≤1 and |b|≤1/3 for convex maps. On |w|=1 the exact defect is 1−a²−8t²+2t[4x³−3(1+a)x], t=|b|, x=cosθ. Exhaustively checking endpoints and critical points gives min 3a−1 for −1≤a≤0 and −(1+a)^{3/2} for 0≤a≤1; quadratic root is B(a)=(1+a)/4 or (1−a)√(1+a)/4. Independently symbolically substituted both roots and checked the boundary polynomial is zero. Since B≤1/4, analytic denominator is zero-free and maximum modulus proves converse including boundaries. B is affine left of 0, strictly concave right and has downward derivative jump, hence region |b|≤B(a) is convex. Finite sampling is not used to prove necessity/sufficiency.
